children.title: Locked atomic write gate
children.intent: WHEN any writer mutates the map THE SYSTEM SHALL validate, lock, and write atomically through one code path

evidence.name: survives concurrent writers without losing adds

children.title: Deep coverage roll-up
children.intent: WHEN coverage is derived THE SYSTEM SHALL mark a parent covered only when every child is

evidence.name: is covered only when every child is at least covered

children.title: Evidence gates on claims
children.intent: WHEN coverage is asserted THE SYSTEM SHALL require evidence for covered and test evidence for verified

evidence.name: refuses covered without evidence and verified without test evidence

children.title: Drift audit and review
children.intent: WHEN cited evidence changes at the unit level or a test run fails THE SYSTEM SHALL flag the claim suspect until re-reviewed

evidence.name: unit-scoped hashing: unrelated edits to an evidence file do not drift the claim

children.title: Intent-change invalidation
children.intent: WHEN an assessed node intent changes THE SYSTEM SHALL mark it suspect until coverage is re-asserted

evidence.name: changing intent on an assessed node marks it suspect

children.title: Budget-capped rendering
children.intent: WHEN the map exceeds the budget THE SYSTEM SHALL cap the payload to area lines plus the top open items by importance

evidence.name: budget digest caps open work at the top importance-sorted items

children.title: Standalone HTML snapshot
children.intent: WHEN a snapshot is requested THE SYSTEM SHALL write a self-contained HTML map page

evidence.name: snapshot writes a self-contained HTML file

children.title: Guidance block install
children.intent: WHEN a map is initialized THE SYSTEM SHALL upsert delimited guidance into CLAUDE.md and an existing AGENTS.md

evidence.name: init upserts AGENTS.md only when it already exists

children.title: Nested map guard on init
children.intent: WHEN init runs inside a repo that already has an ancestor .shape THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse instead of creating a second map

evidence.name: init refuses to create a nested map inside an existing one

children.title: Generated files ignored
children.intent: WHEN a map is initialized THE SYSTEM SHALL keep generated files (snapshot.html, .lock) out of version control

evidence.name: init writes a .shape/.gitignore covering generated files

children.title: Verified means tests pass
children.intent: WHEN a verify command is configured THE SYSTEM SHALL execute the cited tests and refuse verified unless they pass now

evidence.name: with a verify command, verified requires the cited test to pass right now
